category: market data API (stocks, forex, crypto, ETFs, technical indicators)

free_tier.stated: Basic plan USD 0/month: 8 API credits per minute with an 800 per day cap, 8 trial WebSocket credits; real-time US equities, forex and crypto
free_tier.notes: A standard request costs 1 credit per symbol; heavier endpoints weigh more (income_statement is 100 credits per symbol). The daily quota resets to 800 at midnight UTC. Batch requests, technical indicators and a global trial symbol set are on Basic. time_series returns at most 5000 rows per call, and daily intervals hold the complete history since the first trading date for most symbols. The cheapest paid individual plan is Grow at USD 29/month with 55 credits per minute and no daily cap.

per_object_cap.stated: 5000 rows per time_series call (the outputsize maximum)

retention.stated: not applicable: a query API with no stored objects

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the 800 credits a day bound what a free key can pull

interface_detail: GET https://api.twelvedata.com/time_series with symbol, interval and apikey; a WebSocket on trial credits on Basic. Each response carries api-credits-used and api-credits-left headers, and apikey=demo answers for trial symbols.
tooling: curl or any HTTP client; official SDKs and spreadsheet integration are on every plan
chaining: Full daily history in 5000-row pages at 800 credits a day; it pairs with a real-time feed such as the Finnhub free quotes, or with Massive flat files on its paid tiers for a wide universe.

limits.value: 800 API credits per day, reset at midnight UTC

limits_note: Bulk path: no bulk path; batch requests and outputsize=5000 are the widest pulls a free key has.
binding_note: Over a full day the 800 per day cap binds before the 8 per minute rate does.

identity_cost.detail: The signup form asks for a full name, an email and a password of at least 8 characters, or a Google or Apple sign-in; it has no card field. Card and PayPal payment are named for the paid plans. apikey=demo answered a daily time_series call for AAPL with no signup.

reliability_note: A call past the minute's credits answers HTTP 429; Basic covers US markets, with other markets only through trial symbols.
confidence_note: The plan, the credit weights and the daily reset are documented on the pricing page and the support articles. A demo-key probe returned a daily series; the 800-per-day cut-off needs a free key to measure.
